About the Cream City Cycle Club Wednesday Morning Ride group ride

A weekday morning club ride, 25 to 35 miles, with a break near the midpoint. It starts at or near a restaurant and most riders stay for lunch. The start moves each week, so check the club calendar. The club also rides Saturdays and Sundays and runs a women-only ride every other Monday.
